Definition: Kore, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shallum the son of Kore keeps the gates of the tabernacle, Kore the son of Imnah is porter toward the east and distributes the offerings, and Meshelemiah the son of Kore stands among the divisions of the porters. Two men share the name, both at the gate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gatekeepers' names are kept because keeping the gate is holy work, and two Kores did it.
RelatedPeople: Kore, Son of Imnah; Kore, Son of Asaph
